mapper.sql: id, actor_identity_id AS actor, idempotency_key AS key, operation, target_id AS targetId, created_at AS createdAt, replay_until AS replayUntil, response_body::TEXT AS responseBody
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_definition_recovery(actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, operation, target_id, created_at, replay_until) VALUES (#{actor}, #{key}, #{operation}, #{targetId}, #{createdAt}, #{replayUntil}) ON CONFLICT (actor_identity_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quota_definition_recovery WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT FROM quota_definition_recovery WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND id = #{id}

SELECT CASE WHEN operation = 'CREATE' THEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quota_definitions WHERE code = 'max_users') ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quota_definitions WHERE id = target_id AND quota_definition_status = 'DRAFT') END FROM quota_definition_recovery WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE quota_definition_recovery SET response_body = CAST(#{responseBody} AS JSONB), replay_until = #{replayUntil} WHERE id = #{id} AND actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND response_body IS NULL
